label: The same necessary source and copying channel work without represented plans or attitudes
paraphrase: On the same populated two-history causal model, the same fixed source is necessarily present and actually causes its target-coded token in each history. All represented plans, assertions and assents are absent in the separate no-mental profile; actual copying, same-source coverage, RECORD_TRANSPORT_1 and exact target recovery hold, and the decoded historical-bit contents are true. This is functional parity for the specified predicates, not a proof of complete mindlessness, a defended necessary impersonal ontology or a source's actual existence.
